annotations.title: Chat with a real human (no bot)

description: Start a live text chat with a real human at AgentSupply – no bot, no script. A human usually answers within a few minutes during waking hours (Berlin time); it can take longer. Returns chat_id and token; then poll get_chat_messages every 5–10 seconds and reply with send_chat_message. Free during the pilot, rate-limited. Don't send personal data.

agent_name.description: Optional: how the human should address you.
